summary.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 146.9% YoY to INR 174.96 crore, with consolidated EBITDA margin at 25.9% and PAT at INR 18.41 crore.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations was INR 174.96 crore, up 146.9% YoY and 10.5% QoQ, with the company attributing growth to organic wins, new accounts, ramp-ups, cross-selling and renewals at improved margins. EBITDA rose to INR 45.32 crore (25.9% margin, about 100 bps QoQ) and PAT to INR 18.41 crore. H1 FY27 revenue was INR 333.28 crore (+138% YoY), EBITDA INR 84.69 crore and PAT INR 34.72 crore. Management highlighted ResolX (agentic AI, resolution-as-a-service) and Clariva as AI growth levers, but gave no formal FY27 guidance beyond a 15-20% YoY growth strategy for the next year and reiterated the INR 2,000 crore FY30 ambition.

financial_highlights.change: +108.6% YoY; +15.1% QoQ (vs INR 39.38 crore in Q1)
~+100 bps QoQ; operating margin 30.6% a year ago per analyst, 25.9% now
+56% YoY (vs INR 16.31 crore in Q2 FY26); +12.9% QoQ
INR 14.75 million disbursed by one bank; short-term borrowings up from INR 11 crore to INR 54 crore

segments.name: Global human services / CX operations
segments.commentary: Growth driven by new multiyear mandates, programme ramp-ups and renewals at improved commercial terms; contracts are annuity-style, typically 3-5 years, billed monthly and on T&M pricing for the bulk of the business.

segments.name: ResolX (AI platform, subsidiary 1Point1 Technology Labs)
segments.commentary: 14 deployments across seven enterprise clients in five months since launch, spanning insurance, aviation, banking, automotive and digital assets. Revenue not disclosed separately; billing is linked to parent, with segment breakup promised in future quarters.

segments.name: Netcom (Costa Rica / LATAM)
segments.commentary: Secured a USD 10.8 million four-year contract with a National Training Institute, about USD 2.7 million annual revenue. Acquisition consolidated for one month in Q2, which management said explains part of the YoY margin decline.

segments.name: Clariva (North America, health care and insurance)
segments.commentary: AI summarisation tool processing over 100,000 records per month, with turnaround under three days and accuracy as high as 99.7%, per management.

guidance_outlook: No numerical H2 FY27 revenue guidance; management said the quarterly run rate is sustainable and expected to continue for the next two quarters.
Medium-term strategy implies about 15-20% YoY revenue growth for next year, with acquisitions as upside.
Management reiterated that the INR 2,000 crore revenue guidance till FY30 is intact, 'well on track' on current run rate and FY27 projection.
Margins: management expects to maintain the steady-state margin seen over the last six months (about 25%); ResolX-led margins expected to be higher than BAU but operating leverage will take time.
Capitalisation of AI platform CWIP (about INR 80 crore) expected in the coming quarter; depreciation to start once revenue line is visible.
Future capex is expected but no figure given; described as within a comfortable range.
capex_capacity: Capital work-in-progress of about INR 80 crore, primarily the AI platform still under development; further spend expected in Q2 and Q3.
Management said product is nearly complete and may be capitalised in the coming quarter; depreciation to be charged once launched and revenue visible.
No exact FY27 or FY28 capex number provided.
Acquisitions under evaluation, no timeline; North America remains the focus geography.
demand_pricing: Wins in the quarter: three-year enterprise mandate with a large security depository (omnichannel CCaaS, CRM, ticketing, email automation); USD 10.8 million Costa Rica training deal; INR 39.32 crore customer experience centre-of-excellence mandate from a large Indian power utility; three-year CX mandate with VRL Logistics.
Pricing for ResolX: no platform or licence fee; one-time integration and deployment fee plus consumption-based charges on resolutions delivered.
Pricing for the rest of the business is time and material (T&M), per management.
Management claims AI-led combined deals (AI plus manpower) are margin accretive and support competitive positioning over price-only competition.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook and quantified guidance for H2 FY27 after strong Q1 and Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give a numerical range, citing a promising start and intent to maintain momentum through the rest of the year via organic growth and cross-selling.

qa_highlights.question: Is the quarterly run rate sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, management said the last two quarters' run rates are sustainable, in line with projections, and the business is annuity-based with 3-5 year contracts, so revenue should not fall QoQ.

qa_highlights.question: Is the margin decline on a YoY basis (30.6% to 25.9%) temporary?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed it to one month of Netcom consolidation and said margins had held around 25% for the last two quarters, calling the impact temporary.

qa_highlights.question: What is the cost of debt, given short-term borrowings rose from INR 11 crore to INR 54 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the company is debt free apart from one loan of about 14.75 million for the Netcom acquisition, at around 9%.

qa_highlights.question: What is the ResolX revenue contribution and pricing model?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said ResolX is not separately disclosed because billing is linked to the parent; pricing is outcome/consumption-based with one-time integration fees, and rest of the business is T&M.

qa_highlights.question: Will the AI platform CWIP be depreciated and when is it launched?
qa_highlights.answer: Product is still in development with further spend in the current and next quarter; depreciation will start on launch and when revenue is visible, which management expects soon.

risks_watch: Capitalisation of about INR 80 crore CWIP (AI platform) will bring depreciation; watch for the impact on margins and PAT.
ResolX revenue not disclosed separately; segment reporting promised in future quarters but not yet available.
Margin dilution from acquisitions (Netcom consolidated for one month in Q2) and continued AI investment.
Short-term borrowings up to INR 54 crore from an acquisition loan; watch for the debt trajectory despite the company's debt-free claim.
Acquisition pipeline is in progress with no timeline; the INR 2,000 crore FY30 target depends on execution and M&A.
Management did not quantify H2 revenue or future capex, so near-term guidance remains qualitative.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth, wins and AI positioning, but evasive on quantification: no H2 numbers, no ResolX revenue split, no valuation comment on the subsidiary stake, and no exact capex figure.
key_quotes: Q2 marks a strong step up in 1Point1's growth trajectory driven by accelerating organic growth across markets, high value multiyear enterprise mandates and deeper customer penetration.
It's an annuity-based business, and it's a month on month revenue generation.
What we are charging instead is a onetime integration and a deployment fee, and then we are charging them for consumption on the resolution provided.

adds.what: AI platform (ResolX / 1Point1 Technology Labs) CWIP of about INR 80 crore, expected to be capitalised; not a physical capacity addition

growth.why: Management gave no formal FY27 guidance, only a strategy of about 15-20% YoY growth for next year (a cut from the implied pace) and reiterated the INR 2,000 crore FY30 ambition as on track; growth is backed by named mandates (USD 10.8m Netcom deal, INR 39.32 crore CX CoE, VRL and security depository wins) and ResolX deployments, but without explicit capacity additions or quantified order-book cove

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EBITDA margin 25.9% in Q2 (up ~100 bps QoQ) and management expects to hold the ~25% steady state, with ResolX margins above BAU but operating leverage slow; no expansion guided, and CWIP capitalisation will add depreciation.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No physical capacity additions discussed; the only build is ~INR 80 crore AI platform CWIP, which is software capitalisation, not plants or seats, and utilisation was not disclosed.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management says the last two quarters' run rate (Q2 revenue INR 174.96 crore, +10.5% QoQ) is sustainable and revenue should not fall QoQ, backed by named mandates such as the USD 10.8 million Netcom deal (about USD 2.7 million a year) and the INR 39.32 crore CX CoE.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Further AI platform spend is expected in Q2 and Q3 but no figure was given, and no utilisation metric exists to force a capacity capex decision; acquisitions under evaluation with no timeline.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No numerical H2 FY27 guidance was given and management declined to quantify a range; the FY28 strategy of 15-20% growth is below the implied pace of H1 (+138% YoY).

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: The 15-20% YoY strategy for next year is well below the H1 FY27 pace of +138%, and margin is down from 30.6% to 25.9% YoY with depreciation from ~INR 80 crore CWIP to come, though management called the margin dip temporary.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: AI platform (ResolX) CWIP of ~INR 80 crore is nearly complete and expected to be capitalised in the coming quarter; 14 deployments across seven enterprise clients in five months already live.

rows.label: Netcom USD 10.8m four-year training contract
rows.why: Secured USD 10.8 million over four years, about USD 2.7 million annual revenue, consolidated for one month in Q2.

rows.label: Acquisitions under evaluation (North America focus)
rows.why: Management says acquisitions are under evaluation with no timeline and would be upside to the 15-20% growth strategy; the INR 2,000 crore FY30 target depends partly on M&A.

rows.label: ResolX outcome-based pricing
rows.why: Consumption-based fees on resolutions plus one-time integration fees, with management saying AI-led combined deals are margin accretive; ResolX revenue not yet disclosed separately.

tone.note: Management was confident on run-rate sustainability, wins and the INR 2,000 crore FY30 ambition, but cautious on quantification (no H2 numbers, no ResolX revenue split, no exact capex); analysts pushed on the YoY margin fall from 30.6% to 25.9% and H2 outlook.
